definition: גְּשׁוּר proper name, masculine ( bridge ? or land of bridges ? compare Wetzst Hauran, 82 ). 1. of people, = הַגְּשׁוּרִי Josh 13:13 compare 1Chr 2:23 . 2. of land מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר 2Sam 3:3 ; 2Sam 13:37 compare v 2Sam 13:38 (but text in disorder compare ᵐ5 We Dr ) 2Sam 14:32 ; 2Sam 15:8 בַּאֲרָם ׳ בִּגְ 1Chr 3:2 , גְּשׁ֫וּרָה 2Sam 14:23 a territory east of the upper Jordan, exact limits unknown; according to Guthe ZPV xii. 1889, 232 f. between Gilead and Hermon, in Jaulân ; according to Furrer ib. xiii. 1890, 198 = the Ledjah , district east of Jaulân, with town Jisre ; against him Guthe ib. 285 f .
